title: 饮湖上初晴后雨
pinyin: Yǐn Hú Shàng Chū Qíng Hòu Yǔ
englishTitle: Drinking on the Lake, Clear Then Rainy
author: Su Shi

translation: the water's shimmer is lovely in clear weather
the hills' misty colour is wondrous in the rain
i would liken west lake to lady xishi
light makeup or heavy, she is always beautiful

appreciation: Su Shi drinks on West Lake through a change in weather and finds both sun and rain beautiful. The comparison of the lake to Xishi, the legendary beauty, lets him argue that true beauty needs no particular condition to shine. The poem gave West Lake its enduring name, Xizi Lake.
